user.title: Nexus MCP: Inference Provider
user.description:
Select the AI brain for Nexus MCP. Free cloud and local options are available:

• **Google Gemini**: Free tier with Google AI Studio key. [Get free key at Google AI Studio]({gemini_api_url})
• **Groq Cloud (Recommended in Europe)**: 100% free with instant Google login (14,400 req/day). [Get free key at Groq Console]({groq_api_url})
• **Qwen Cloud (DashScope)**: Millions of free tokens with newest Qwen models. [Get free key at Alibaba Cloud Model Studio]({qwen_api_url})
• **Ollama Local**: 100% free and private on your own PC.
• **OpenAI / OpenRouter / Custom**: Bring your own key. [Get key at OpenRouter]({openrouter_api_url})

gemini.title: Google Gemini (Free Tier)
gemini.description:
To use Google Gemini, you need a free API key from Google AI Studio.

👉 **[Get your free Gemini API Key here]({api_key_url})** *(URL: https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey)*
*(Free tier requires no credit card or billing).*

**Available Models:**
• `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` (Recommended): 500 free requests per day.
• `gemini-flash-latest`: Always Google's newest Flash (Gemini 3.8 Flash), but limited to 20 requests per day on free tier.

Paste your API key and chosen model below:

data_description.api_key: Generate your free API key at https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey
data_description.model: Use 'gemini-3.1-flash-lite' (500 req/day, recommended) or 'gemini-flash-latest' (latest Flash, 20 req/day on free tier).

groq.title: Groq Cloud (Free Tier - Europe & Worldwide)
groq.description:
To use Groq Cloud, get a free API key from Groq Console. 1-click login with Google or GitHub, no credit card or phone verification needed.

👉 **[Get your free Groq API Key here]({groq_api_url})** *(URL: https://console.groq.com/keys)*
👉 **[Check official Groq models list here]({groq_models_url})** *(URL: https://console.groq.com/docs/models)*

**Included Models & Limits:**
• `openai/gpt-oss-120b` (Default): 120-Billion open-weights reasoning model with deep tool calling.
• `qwen/qwen3.8-27b`: High-speed multilingual Qwen on Groq LPUs (~0.08s latency).
• `openai/gpt-oss-20b`: Lightweight and ultra-fast 20B open model.

Enter your API key and model below:

data_description.api_key: Generate your free API key at https://console.groq.com/keys

qwen.title: Qwen Cloud (Alibaba Model Studio / DashScope)
qwen.description:
To use Qwen Cloud, you need a free API key from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (DashScope), which includes millions of free tokens without Google's tight daily request limits.

👉 **[Get your free Qwen/DashScope API Key here]({qwen_api_url})** *(URL: https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/)*
*(Available internationally with free registration).* 

**Configured Model:**
• `qwen-plus-latest`: Always points to the newest released version of Qwen Plus.
• Also supports `qwen-turbo-latest` or `qwen2.5-coder-32b-instruct`.

Enter your API key and model below:

data_description.api_key: Generate your free API key at https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/
data_description.model: 'qwen-plus-latest' always points to the newest available release of Qwen Plus.

ollama.title: Ollama Local (Qwen 2.5 Coder)
ollama.description: Connect to your local Ollama instance running Qwen Coder.

data_description.base_url: URL where Ollama is listening (default: http://127.0.0.1:11434).
data_description.model: Model tag to use (e.g. qwen2.5-coder:7b or qwen2.5-coder:latest).

custom_openai.title: OpenAI / OpenRouter / Custom BYOK
custom_openai.description:
Connect to any OpenAI-compatible provider or multi-model proxy:

• 👉 **[Get free API key at OpenRouter]({openrouter_api_url})** *(URL: https://openrouter.ai/keys - Free Qwen models available)*
• 👉 **[Get API key at OpenAI Platform]({openai_api_url})** *(URL: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys)*
• 👉 **[Get API key at DeepSeek Platform]({deepseek_api_url})** *(URL: https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys)*

Enter your provider details and API key below:

data_description.base_url: OpenAI-compatible base URL (OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 | OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1).
data_description.api_key: Your API key for this provider (OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/keys | OpenAI: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys).

mcp_server.title: HA-MCP Server Connection
mcp_server.description:
Nexus MCP connects to an MCP server to provide advanced actions and automation capabilities.

• If you already have **ha-mcp** installed, the endpoint URL was auto-detected below.
• If you don't have it installed yet, you can get it at the official 👉 **[HA-MCP GitHub Repository]({ha_mcp_repo_url})** *(URL: https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp)* via HACS.

Configure the connection details:

data.autonomous_mode: Autonomous Mode (Execute actions without asking confirmation)

data_description.mcp_server_url: Auto-detected from ha_mcp_tools. If not installed, get it at https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp
data_description.autonomous_mode: If enabled, Nexus MCP will execute actions without requiring an interactive confirmation prompt.

init.title: Nexus MCP Settings & Credentials
init.description:
Configure your Nexus MCP agent settings, credentials, and endpoints. To get or renew your API keys / tokens:

• **Google Gemini**: 👉 [Get key at Google AI Studio]({gemini_api_url}) *(https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey)*
• **Groq Cloud (Recommended in Europe)**: 👉 [Get key at Groq Console]({groq_api_url}) *(https://console.groq.com/keys)* | [Model Catalog]({groq_models_url}) *(https://console.groq.com/docs/models)*
• **Qwen Cloud**: 👉 [Get key at Alibaba Model Studio]({qwen_api_url}) *(https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/)*
• **OpenRouter**: 👉 [Get key at OpenRouter]({openrouter_api_url}) *(https://openrouter.ai/keys)*
• **HA-MCP Tools**: 👉 [GitHub Repository]({ha_mcp_repo_url}) *(https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp)*

data_description.api_key: Update your API key/token here. Links to obtain keys for each provider are listed above.
data_description.base_url: Endpoint Base URL for your provider.
data_description.autonomous_mode: If enabled, Nexus MCP will create automations directly. If disabled (default), it will explain what it understood and ask for your confirmation before proceeding.
